name: WEEDY Top Japanese Pain Gel | Rapid Relief from Muscle Tension | 100g
description:
Mitsuseiyaku Soothing Massage Gel is an advanced Japanese pain relief gel designed to relieve discomfort in the back, knees, neck, shoulders, and joints. Enriched with AJUNOGUCOSE, Hyaluronic Acid, and Mugwort Oil, it penetrates deeply, repairs cartilage, and reduces inflammation naturally. The quick-absorbing, non-sticky, and paraben-free formula makes it suitable for athletes, elderly, or anyone suffering from muscle tension or strain.
Key Features
 Rapid relief for muscle and joint pain
 Enriched with AJUNOGUCOSE, Hyaluronic Acid & Mugwort Oil
 Deep penetration for effective healing
 Quick-absorbing and non-sticky formula
 Paraben-free and safe for daily use
How to Use
 Apply a small amount to the affected area
 Massage gently until absorbed
 Use 2–3 times daily or as needed
Material/Composition
AJUNOGUCOSE, Hyaluronic Acid, Mugwort Oil, soothing herbal extracts
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes and open wounds
 Keep out of reach of children
